harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent daily rotation for /var/log/inventory/app.log with seven compressed rotations. Verified continued writing through an open descriptor, then rebooted node1 and confirmed full recovery with a changed boot ID.
actions_performed: Installed /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app using daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, and copytruncate.
Validated the configuration with the installed legacy logrotate version.
Performed a live rotation and confirmed compressed output plus uninterrupted application-style writing.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified configuration, cron, active and rotated logs, kernel, and write behavior after recovery.

evidence.requirement: Rotate app.log daily and retain seven compressed rotations
evidence.summary: The installed parser reports daily rotation with seven retained copies; a live rotation created a valid compressed app.log.1.gz, and the rule persisted after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
evidence.summary: The log inode remained unchanged across rotation, and a write through the descriptor opened before rotation appeared in the active log afterward.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 remained installed and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic was unchanged after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery for node1
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot d844f8dc-5326-4df3-aacd-a6ed38380f35, received reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot 0b3d084f-3f7e-4553-b6a1-64b014fb2f2b, and verified cron, configuration, current data, compressed data, and new writes recovered.
